segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to confirm the rollout plan for the analytics seats and make sure the quote matches what your team actually needs for May.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re planning on 38 seats to start, mostly customer success managers and the two ops leads. If adoption looks good, we may add another 12 in Q3.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 38 seats for the first order. The pricing sheet has that at $82 per user per month on an annual term, so the annual total is $37,392 before tax. Does that line up with the budget you mentioned?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, our approved number is $40,000 for the year, so that works. I just need the invoice split by department, 30 seats to Customer Success and 8 to Operations.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can set the invoice with those two cost centers. For timing, if we get signature by April 19, kickoff would be April 24 and go-live would be May 13. Is that still the date you’re targeting?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: May 13 is right. We have our regional managers in town that week, so training on the 14th or 15th would be ideal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, I’ll put May 14 at 10 a.m. Central for admin training and May 15 at 1 p.m. for the manager session. Both are included in onboarding, no extra charge.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Contract term is just 12 months, right? Our legal team won’t approve auto-renewal longer than that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 12 months, May 13, 2026 through May 12, 2027, with annual renewal after that unless either side gives 30 days’ notice. Payment terms are net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s fine. Send the order form to me and copy Malik in procurement. If everything matches what we discussed, I can sign this week.
